pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with predominantly smooth edge gradients. Patches on the lower neck show greater longitudinal elongation compared to the more equilateral geometry of the mid-flank patches.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous topological graph of light-colored pathways. Junction nodes are primarily triradiate (3-way). Pathway width is consistent throughout the mid-flank, with slight widening toward the ventral region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Fine-textured, low-amplitude serrated silhouette along the dorsal neck ridge.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A distinct interruption in the continuous mane line is visible at the base of the neck where it joins the shoulder.

other_distinctive_markers: The tail is held in an upward, anteriorly-curved posture over the hindquarters, creating a distinct curved silhouette against the background.
